**Ralph M. Benítez** is a Mexican-American Mattel employee who has been working with Mattel since 2013. Benítez initially did packaging design for various Mattel lines before joining the Hot Wheels team in 2016, doing graphic designs for various Hot Wheels cars; he currently works on "secret projects" and does graphics for [Color Shifters](/wiki/Color_Shifters), [Super Rigs](/wiki/Super_Rigs), [Track Fleet](/wiki/Track_Fleet), [Silver Series](/wiki/Themed_assortment) and [Pull-Back Speeders](/wiki/Pull-Back_Speeders) among other things. He was previously lead graphic designer on the [Hot Wheels id](/wiki/Hot_Wheels_id) series and a contributing designer on [Virtual Garage](/wiki/Virtual_Garage) products. Outside of his normal line of work, he is an electronic music producer whose works can be found on Soundcloud.
